title: Senior Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
URHRO is focused on partnering in the growth of its clients by providing solutions that help organizations scale efficiently and sustainably. The company emphasizes collaboration, aiming to work closely with partners to understand their challenges and deliver practical, results-oriented support. URHRO values long-term relationships built on trust, transparency, and measurable impact. Team members are encouraged to bring forward-looking ideas that contribute directly to client success and organizational improvement.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time Senior Engineer role at URHRO is a hybrid position based in Kalyan Dombivli, with the flexibility to work from home for part of the week. The Senior Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining technical solutions that support client growth and operational efficiency. Daily activities include analyzing requirements, troubleshooting issues, improving system performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality delivery. The role involves providing technical guidance, reviewing code or system designs, documenting engineering best practices, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. The Senior Engineer will also interact with internal and external stakeholders to understand needs, align solutions, and support a positive experience throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Customer Satisfaction and Customer Service skills to ensure high-quality outcomes and positive stakeholder experiences.
* Candidates should possess Customer Support and Communication skills to address issues effectively and convey technical information clearly.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to diagnose problems, optimize systems, and make data-informed decisions.
* Relevant experience in engineering roles, with a track record of delivering reliable, scalable solutions.
* Proficiency in common engineering tools, technologies, and methodologies appropriate to the organization’s tech stack.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment, manage time independently, and collaborate across distributed teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning, quality standards, and ethical, inclusive workplace practices.

title: Chief Architect
description:
**Company Description**
RA Logistics is a growing logistics and supply chain organization focused on delivering reliable, efficient, and cost-effective solutions to its clients. The company is committed to optimizing transportation, warehousing, and distribution operations through process excellence and technology-driven innovation. RA Logistics values collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement to better serve diverse industries and customers. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, take ownership of outcomes, and support high operational standards. The organization offers opportunities for professional growth in a dynamic environment.

**Role Description**
The Chief Architect is a full-time, on-site role based in Bhiwandi. This position is responsible for defining and overseeing the overall technical and architectural vision for RA Logistics’ systems and platforms. Day-to-day responsibilities include designing scalable architectures, guiding software development efforts, and ensuring seamless integration between internal and external systems. The Chief Architect works closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, establish standards and best practices, and review designs and implementations for quality and performance. The role also involves mentoring technical staff, coordinating with project managers, and supporting long-term technology roadmaps that align with the company’s strategic goals.

**Qualifications**

* Strong background in Architecture and Architectural Design, with experience defining enterprise or large-scale system architectures.
* Hands-on experience in Software Development, including designing, building, and maintaining complex applications or platforms.
* Expertise in Integration, with the ability to design and manage interfaces between systems, applications, and third-party services.
* Proven Project Management skills, including planning, prioritizing, and coordinating technical work across multiple initiatives.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in logistics, supply chain, or related industries is an advantage.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, including mentoring, decision-making, and driving alignment on architectural standards.
